About the work

From a measured plan to a finished room

This portfolio collects interior design work completed in 2026. Each project begins with measuring and hand-drafting a space at ¼″ = 1′ scale, then builds toward the furniture, color, light and materials that give the room its character.

01

Bedroom Concept Renderings

Concept rendering

Coastal Serenity Bedroom

A light-filled bedroom built on soft blues, greens and natural textures. The striped, arched headboard echoes the arched window behind it, and paired hydrangea prints and nightstands create a calm, symmetrical composition. A capiz-shell chandelier, rattan vanity and scalloped rug layer in texture without disturbing the airy palette.

Palette
Sky blue, sage, ivory, natural oak
Principles
Symmetry, repetition

Concept rendering

Sea Turtle Modern Bedroom

A modern bedroom that puts complementary color to work. Deep navy and teal upholstery sit against a terracotta rug and burnt-orange lamps, and the sea-turtle mosaic triptych becomes the focal point — its orange shell ties the warm accents to the cool base. Matching nightstands, lamps and snake plants keep the bold palette balanced.

Palette
Navy, teal, sage, terracotta
Principles
Contrast, emphasis, balance
02

Home Office: Board and Plan

Presentation board

Home Office and Lounge

A warm, traditional office arranged around the measured floor plan at the center of the board. Each selection is labeled: a leather armchair, rolled-arm sofa, turned-leg wood tables, writing desk with leather task chair, open bookshelf and ceiling fan. Dark wood flooring, linen curtains, an olive tree and a framed landscape complete an earthy, layered palette.

Medium
Hand-assembled board
Palette
Walnut, cognac leather, cream

Floor plan

Home Office Floor Plan

The measured plan behind the presentation board. The desk sits centered in an angled bay window, framed by storage on either side. A separate alcove holds a sofa, two armchairs, side tables and a coffee table arranged for conversation. Wall lengths, the door swing, the closet and the clearances between furniture are all dimensioned.

Scale
¼″ = 1′ on grid paper
Dated
April 2026
03

Space Planning and Drafting

Space planning

Bedroom Floor Plan

A measured bedroom plan with each wall dimensioned — 18′, 14′, 16′6″ and 9′ — along with a 2′6″ door and its swing. The bed is centered on the window wall between two windows, with nightstands on either side, leaving a clear path from the entry. A north arrow orients the room.

Scale
¼″ = 1′ on grid paper
Dated
March 2026

Drafting

Kitchen and Dining Plan

An L-shaped kitchen with the cooktop on the main run, an island with a sink and seating for four, and a dining nook with an oval table, bench and window wall. The same layout is shown twice: first as a pencil draft on grid paper, then refined into a final inked drawing with consistent line weights and a title block.

04

Design Foundations

Study

Elements and Principles

A hand-annotated collage that finds the principles of design in real spaces: balance and symmetry in a vaulted arcade, lines creating movement in a wave-form interior, a spiral stair guiding the eye in a circle, natural light bringing the outdoors in, and contrasting colors arranged asymmetrically.

Medium
Collage, hand annotation
Focus
Line, shape, texture, color, light

Materials

Material Palette

A tactile palette that explores how one hue — green — reads across very different surfaces, grounded by wood tones and a warm neutral. Physical samples include commercial textiles from Maharam and Momentum.

  • Dark walnut-tone veneer
  • Light ash veneer
  • Moss-green knit
  • Celery linen weave
  • Forest-green cork
  • Taupe textured weave
